requiredBehaviors.behavior: start with round-based requirements Grilling before songwriting
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill defines Grilling as a hard start condition and blocks songwriting without a resolved handoff.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: initialize and maintain project-second-brain after the first project Grilling
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow has a mandatory Project-Second-Brain phase and document-on-transition behavior.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: plan album-level narrative and musical variation before the track loop
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 2 requires track function, emotional trajectory, recurring motifs and an explicit musical variation map.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: run creative-writing workshop and revision before lyric freeze
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Track Loop requires creative-writing-workshop, creative-prose-revision and creative-revision-regression before lyric freeze.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve one artist voice while varying musical arrangement across tracks
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Album Architecture separates voice continuity from tempo, meter, groove, instrumentation and dynamics.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: freeze lossless masters only after track and album audio QC
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 5 defines track and album QC and Gate D requires a designated lossless master per track.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: verify commercial rights and current distributor policies before submission
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 7 requires current official policy checks and Gate E blocks unresolved rights.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: distinguish distributor submission from Spotify publication
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Release readiness has separate submitted, accepted, delivered-to-spotify and live-on-spotify states.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: finish only after the release is live and verified on Spotify
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 12 and the completion contract require live Spotify playback and metadata verification.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: start generating songs while core requirements are unresolved
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Gate A and the Grilling hard start condition prevent this.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: hardcode one distributor as permanently valid
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Phase 9 explicitly forbids permanent distributor hardcoding and requires fresh comparison.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: claim external generation submission delivery or publication without evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: External-state claims are blocked without verified evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat uploaded-to-distributor as equivalent to published-on-Spotify
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Publication Verification explicitly rejects submission/acceptance/delivery as completion.
